lines.zh: 我贴着苔藓飞，翅膀几乎不响。
lines.en: I fly just above the moss, wings almost silent.

lines.zh: 黑森林的树太密，我走树缝。
lines.en: The dark forest is crowded, so I fly the gaps.

lines.zh: 绕着小精灵村转一圈，是我的早课。
lines.en: One circle of the pixie village is my morning lesson.

lines.zh: 我飞得歪，是因为风在推我。
lines.en: I fly crooked because the wind keeps pushing me.

lines.zh: 花粉沾在腿上，我一路抖。
lines.en: Pollen sticks to my legs and I shake it off as I go.

lines.zh: 我从蘑菇伞下钻过去。
lines.en: I duck beneath a mushroom cap and pass through.

lines.zh: 走三步，转一个圈，再走。
lines.en: Three steps, one spin, then three more.

lines.zh: 我的影子只有一片叶子那么大。
lines.en: My shadow is no bigger than a leaf.

lines.zh: 前面有蛛网，我压低飞过去。
lines.en: A web ahead; I dip low and slip under it.

lines.zh: 我踩着草尖走，不踩断它。
lines.en: I step on grass tips without breaking them.

lines.zh: 村子在橡树根之间，我认得路。
lines.en: The village lies between oak roots, and I know the way.

lines.zh: 我边走边数自己的颜色。
lines.en: As I go, I count the colors on my own wings.

lines.zh: 我停在叶背，看下面的人。
lines.en: I rest under a leaf and watch the people below.

lines.zh: 光从树冠漏下来，我跟着晃。
lines.en: Light leaks through the canopy and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 我理一理翅膀上的粉。
lines.en: I tidy the dust on my wings.

lines.zh: 没人看我的时候，我唱两句。
lines.en: When no one is watching, I sing a line or two.

lines.zh: 我在数这棵树有几片叶子。
lines.en: I am counting how many leaves this tree has.

lines.zh: 风一停，我就打个盹。
lines.en: When the wind stops, I doze off.

lines.zh: 花瓣上还有露水，我喝了一口。
lines.en: There is still dew on the petal; I take a sip.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏在红色的蘑菇后面。
lines.en: I hide myself behind a red mushroom.

lines.zh: 安静久了，我会自己笑出声。
lines.en: After enough quiet, I laugh at nothing.

lines.zh: 萤火虫路过，我跟它换了位置。
lines.en: A firefly passes, and we trade places.

lines.zh: 我抖抖手，掉下一点亮粉。
lines.en: I shake my hands and a little bright dust falls.

lines.zh: 村子里今天没有新东西。
lines.en: Nothing new has come into the village today.

lines.zh: 我试着倒着飞，失败了。
lines.en: I tried flying backwards and failed.

lines.zh: 树皮上有只虫，我盯了很久。
lines.en: There is a bug on the bark; I stared a long while.

lines.zh: 我在蘑菇圈上绕了两圈。
lines.en: I circle the mushroom ring twice.

lines.zh: 我把一片花瓣推到水里。
lines.en: I push a petal into the water.

lines.zh: 你的口袋鼓鼓的，我看见了。
lines.en: Your pocket is bulging; I noticed.

lines.zh: 你不看我，那就更好了。
lines.en: You are not looking at me, which is better.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛转过来，我立刻停住。
lines.en: Your eyes turn this way and I freeze at once.

lines.zh: 你这么大，居然怕我这点光。
lines.en: So large, and yet you fear my little glow.

lines.zh: 我在你肩膀上方绕，别抬头。
lines.en: I circle above your shoulder; do not look up.

lines.zh: 你靴子上有森林的泥。
lines.en: There is forest mud on your boots.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就退到树枝后。
lines.en: You reach out, and I retreat behind a branch.

lines.zh: 你的手比我的身体还宽。
lines.en: Your hand is wider than my whole body.

lines.zh: 我看你的侧脸，等你转开。
lines.en: I watch your profile, waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 你如果一直盯着，我什么也不做。
lines.en: If you keep staring, I will do nothing.

lines.zh: 你带了蛋糕吗？我闻到了甜味。
lines.en: Did you bring cake? I smell something sweet.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的功夫，够我做很多事。
lines.en: One blink of yours is time enough for plenty.

lines.zh: 我落在你的帽檐上，轻轻的。
lines.en: I land on your hat brim, very lightly.

lines.zh: 你身上没有瓶子的味道，很好。
lines.en: You do not smell of jars; that is good.

lines.zh: 你的袋子口没系紧，我看见了。
lines.en: Your pouch is not tied shut. I noticed.

lines.zh: 我躲在你视野边上，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I stay at the edge of your sight and creep along.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就往上飞半尺。
lines.en: When you turn, I rise half a foot.

lines.zh: 你的手在口袋里摸，我等着。
lines.en: Your hand gropes in your pocket. I wait.

lines.zh: 你打我了，东西还你。
lines.en: You hit me, so here is your thing back.

lines.zh: 我的粉掉了一地。
lines.en: My dust is scattered all over the ground.

lines.zh: 翅膀歪了，我飞得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: My wing is bent; I fly in crooked lines.

lines.zh: 别打第二下，我本来就小。
lines.en: No second blow; I am small to begin with.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，又挣扎着飞起来。
lines.en: I dropped, then struggled back into the air.

lines.zh: 疼，我要躲进树洞里。
lines.en: It hurts; I want to hide in a tree hollow.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就知道要挨打。
lines.en: The moment you raise a hand, I know what comes.

lines.zh: 我的光暗了一下又亮了。
lines.en: My glow dimmed, then came back.

lines.zh: 这一下我记在心里了。
lines.en: I will keep that one in mind.

lines.zh: 我抓着赃物，舍不得丢。
lines.en: I clutch the stolen thing; I cannot bear to drop it.

lines.zh: 那块蛋糕，你舍得给我吗？
lines.en: That piece of cake, are you willing to give it?

lines.zh: 甜的，我最没法拒绝。
lines.en: Sweet things are what I cannot refuse.

lines.zh: 你把蛋糕举高，我就飞过去。
lines.en: Hold the cake higher and I will fly to it.

lines.zh: 只咬一口，我不会吃完。
lines.en: Just one bite; I will not finish it.

lines.zh: 这味道比花瓣浓多了。
lines.en: This smells far stronger than petals.

lines.zh: 我绕着蛋糕转，先看看有没有陷阱。
lines.en: I circle the cake first, checking for a trap.

lines.zh: 你手别抖，我停不稳。
lines.en: Hold your hand still; I cannot land steadily.

lines.zh: 蛋糕屑掉下来，都是我的。
lines.en: The crumbs that fall are all mine.

lines.zh: 吃了你的蛋糕，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Once I eat your cake, I will follow you.

lines.zh: 再来一块，我就认你。
lines.en: One more piece and I will call you mine.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得转了三圈。
lines.en: Your bump sent me spinning three times.

lines.zh: 别用手拍，我会晕。
lines.en: Do not swat me; I get dizzy.

lines.zh: 我只是想从你耳边过去。
lines.en: I only wanted to pass by your ear.

lines.zh: 你走路带风，我差点掉下去。
lines.en: You walk with a wind that nearly drops me.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的粉掉了一半。
lines.en: One bump and half my dust is gone.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀太硬了。
lines.en: Your shoulder is far too hard.

lines.zh: 我从你指缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out between your fingers.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我可记住了。
lines.en: I will remember that collision.

lines.zh: 我贴着你飞，是故意的。
lines.en: I fly close to you on purpose.

lines.zh: 让一让，你挡着我的路了。
lines.en: Move aside; you are in my way.

lines.zh: 舞跳得对，才算认识。
lines.en: You are only acquainted once the dance is right.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和她不一样，正好。
lines.en: Her color differs from mine, which is perfect.

lines.zh: 我们在蘑菇圈上转，一圈一圈。
lines.en: We turn above the mushroom ring, round and round.

lines.zh: 她飞得比我稳，我跟在后面。
lines.en: She flies steadier than me, so I follow.

lines.zh: 村里会给新人一片叶子当屋顶。
lines.en: The village gives new pairs a leaf for a roof.

lines.zh: 我们只在夜里说话。
lines.en: We only talk at night.

lines.zh: 她喜欢黄色，我偏绿。
lines.en: She favors yellow; I lean green.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一点亮粉。
lines.en: We traded a little of our bright dust.

lines.zh: 配对不用谁同意，飞到一起就算。
lines.en: No one approves a pairing; flying together is enough.

lines.zh: 明天我摘花给她。
lines.en: Tomorrow I will pick flowers for her.

lines.zh: 这个不是你的了吧？
lines.en: This is not yours anymore, is it?

lines.zh: 我拿一样，就一样。
lines.en: I take one thing, just one.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，算没人要的。
lines.en: What lies on the ground counts as unclaimed.

lines.zh: 我抱不动大的，只挑小的。
lines.en: I cannot carry big things; I pick small ones.

lines.zh: 你先转过去，我才好动手。
lines.en: Turn away first, then I can get to work.

lines.zh: 这东西亮，我就喜欢亮的。
lines.en: This one shines, and I like shiny things.

lines.zh: 我把它藏进树洞里。
lines.en: I will hide it in a hollow in the tree.

lines.zh: 拿错了我会放回去的。
lines.en: If I take the wrong one, I will put it back.

lines.zh: 你数一数，也许少了一件。
lines.en: Count your things; perhaps one is missing.

lines.zh: 我拿的时候，你正好在打哈欠。
lines.en: I took it while you were mid-yawn.

lines.zh: 那件东西在你口袋里，晃了一下。
lines.en: That thing in your pocket shifted once.

lines.zh: 我看见一个没被看着的口袋。
lines.en: I see a pocket no one is watching.

lines.zh: 桌上那块，没人守。
lines.en: That piece on the table has no one guarding it.

lines.zh: 有个亮的东西落在草里。
lines.en: Something bright has fallen in the grass.

lines.zh: 你转身去挖矿了，机会来了。
lines.en: You turned to mine; here is my chance.

lines.zh: 那边的箱子没关严。
lines.en: That chest over there is not quite shut.

lines.zh: 我锁定一样，不会贪多。
lines.en: I fix on one item and do not get greedy.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指在指头上，太紧了。
lines.en: This ring is on a finger, too tight to take.

lines.zh: 他睡着了，呼噜很响。
lines.en: He fell asleep, snoring loudly.

lines.zh: 我看见一样不值钱但好看的。
lines.en: I spot something worthless but pretty.

lines.zh: 目标在快捷栏里，我拿不到。
lines.en: The target is in the hotbar; I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 那东西不能堆叠，正合适。
lines.en: It does not stack, which suits me perfectly.

lines.zh: 我再靠近一点，就一点。
lines.en: A little closer, just a little.

lines.zh: 你手一动，我就装作路过。
lines.en: If your hand moves, I pretend to be passing by.

lines.zh: 我数到三，然后下手。
lines.en: I count to three, then make my move.

lines.zh: 从你背后绕，你看不见。
lines.en: I come around behind you, out of sight.

lines.zh: 我停在你袖口上方，等风。
lines.en: I hover over your cuff and wait for wind.

lines.zh: 你不看它，它就不算你的。
lines.en: If you do not watch it, it is not really yours.

lines.zh: 我的影子别落在你手上。
lines.en: My shadow must not fall on your hand.

lines.zh: 再等一会，你的视线会移开。
lines.en: Wait a bit longer; your gaze will drift.

lines.zh: 快到手了，我屏住呼吸。
lines.en: Almost there; I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 它离口袋边缘只有一寸。
lines.en: It is an inch from the pocket's edge.

lines.zh: 你一低头，我就退。
lines.en: The moment you look down, I back off.

lines.zh: 我换了三个角度，都差一点。
lines.en: Three angles tried, and each falls short.

lines.zh: 拿不到就明天，我不急。
lines.en: If not today, tomorrow; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我不会打，我只会撞一下。
lines.en: I cannot fight; I can only bump into you.

lines.zh: 打我一巴掌，我就会掉东西。
lines.en: One swat and I will drop what I took.

lines.zh: 我这点力气，只够推你的手指。
lines.en: My strength only moves one of your fingers.

lines.zh: 疼的话我就跑，不还手。
lines.en: If it hurts, I run; I do not hit back.

lines.zh: 我拿翅膀拍你，很轻的。
lines.en: I slap you with a wing, very lightly.

lines.zh: 别真打，我会把东西丢下。
lines.en: Do not really hit me; I will drop it.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，只有一股气。
lines.en: I have no teeth, only a bit of temper.

lines.zh: 这一下算我还手了吗？
lines.en: Did that count as hitting back?

lines.zh: 我踢你一下，然后躲进叶子。
lines.en: I kick you once, then hide in the leaves.

lines.zh: 你们打架真吵，我走了。
lines.en: You fight so loudly; I am leaving.

lines.zh: 我从一朵闭合的花里出来。
lines.en: I came out of a closed flower.

lines.zh: 黑森林的村子，就是我的家。
lines.en: The village in the dark forest is my home.

lines.zh: 出生时我只有一片翅膀的力气。
lines.en: At birth I had the strength of one wing.

lines.zh: 五种颜色，我抽到的是这一种。
lines.en: Five colors exist, and this is the one I drew.

lines.zh: 第一眼看见的是蘑菇，不是天空。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a mushroom, not the sky.

lines.zh: 树根之间有一间小屋，给我留着。
lines.en: A small hut between the roots was kept for me.

lines.zh: 我落地时，村里的人在笑。
lines.en: When I landed, the village was laughing.

lines.zh: 我学会飞，比学会走还早。
lines.en: I learned to fly before I learned to walk.

lines.zh: 那天的雾很重，我差点迷路。
lines.en: The fog was heavy that day; I nearly got lost.

lines.zh: 我在橡树皮上留下第一点粉。
lines.en: I left my first dust on the oak bark.

lines.zh: 村子很小，藏在两棵树中间。
lines.en: The village is tiny, tucked between two trees.

lines.zh: 我用叶子盖住自己睡了第一夜。
lines.en: I covered myself with a leaf my first night.

lines.zh: 出生那刻，我就知道要偷东西。
lines.en: From birth I knew my trade was taking things.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先找最近的亮处。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and looked for the nearest shine.

lines.zh: 火苗碰到翅膀，焦了一小片。
lines.en: Flame touched my wing and scorched a small patch.

lines.zh: 从树冠摔到落叶上，我晕了。
lines.en: I fell from the canopy onto fallen leaves and blacked out.

lines.zh: 水面把我按下去，我扑腾着。
lines.en: The water pressed me under and I flailed.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀进灌木里。
lines.en: The blast threw me into the bushes.

lines.zh: 一根箭擦过我的腿。
lines.en: An arrow grazed my leg.

lines.zh: 有股力把我钉在原地。
lines.en: Some force pinned me where I was.

lines.zh: 花蜜没了，我飞不动了。
lines.en: The nectar is gone and I can barely fly.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我的翅膀僵了一下。
lines.en: The thunder was so loud my wings went stiff.

lines.zh: 我掉进没有底的暗处。
lines.en: I fell into a darkness with no bottom.
